question: What claim is being made here about the yoginī named by will and the extent of her domain?
premises: The yoginī named by will is in question.
She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will her domain extends up to the end of Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named by will, in association with the siddhas, extends up to the end of Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise mode of association with the siddhas is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā through the siddhas.
